payload.name: n-eicosane
payload.rationale: Requested by task 312c5c4a: melting point of n-eicosane with MACE-MPA-0.

_fulfilled_need.query: Compute the melting point of n-eicosane with the MACE-MPA-0 force field.

payload.reason: Premise check failed; no melting point computed. (1) Model domain: MACE-MPA-0 is trained on PBE/PBE+U inorganic data (MPtrj + sAlex) and has no explicit dispersion correction. The n-eicosane crystal is held together by van der Waals interchain forces, and those set Tm. A probe (/work/scripts/probe.py, float32, cuda) placed two relaxed all-trans C20H42 chains side by side and found unphysical interchain binding: -2.63 eV (-254 kJ/mol) at 4.0 A, -0.48 eV (-46 kJ/mol) at 6.0 A, ~0 at 9 A. This is far stronger than plausible dispersion binding between two alkane chains (for scale, the measured fusion enthalpies of C16/C18 in tier1.json are about 53-60 kJ/mol per molecule). The model is outside its domain, so any Tm would be an artefact. (2) Method/timescale: a defensible Tm needs solid-liquid coexistence (or free-energy) runs of several thousand atoms (~50-100 molecules x 62 atoms) over multiple ns at a 0.5-1 fs step, because chain alkanes crystallise slowly. Heating a crystal would only give a superheating limit. Measured cost here: ~12 s per force call for 3968 atoms (ASE calculator path), so 1 ns would take ~10^6-10^7 steps, far beyond the available compute and budget. (3) Validation: the required independent check is to recover n-hexadecane (291.0 K) or n-octadecane (301.0 K) from tier1.json with the same setup. That is blocked by the same two problems. Well-posed alternative: use a dispersion-capable model (MACE-MPA-0 + D3(BJ), or a model trained on molecular/organic data such as MACE-OFF). First check it against measured n-octadecane density and fusion enthalpy and against the C16/C18 Tm in tier1.json. Then run interface-pinning or direct-coexistence NPT on a triclinic C20 slab with >=4000 atoms for >=2-5 ns per temperature, with a GPU-native neighbour list. Report the bracket width plus a finite-size estimate as the uncertainty.

summary: refused: melting_point of n-eicosane (C20H42) with MACE-MPA-0 (Premise check failed; no melting point computed. (1) Model domain: MACE-MPA-0 is trained on PBE/PBE+)
